provenance.derived_from: Shiny Wall 1.1.4 (com.shinywall.shinywall, versionCode 101), local analysis artefacts
provenance.method: Grid and row heights from the app's Standard/Mini rendering code (blutter reconstruction); index structure from cross-variant pairing of catalogue routes; vertical order from start/top statistics; row directions (serpentine) from minimising the lateral spread of all catalogue routes; absolute left/right, kicker order and names anchored by the lit route in the app's product photo (unique catalogue match), the two missing small-hold assets and hold shapes. No position table exists in the app; positions come per wall from the vendor backend.
provenance.coordinates: col/row 0-based, origin bottom-left as seen from the front (row grows upward). col = the app's column index inside its row (offset rows have columns-1 cells). x/y = hold centre in units of one full-row cell width: x=0 is the centre of the leftmost full-row cell, offset-row cells sit at half positions; y=0 is the centre of the lowest row, rows use the app's relative heights (big row 1.0, small row 0.25, kicker row 2/3).

st0.hold_count_source: structure 15x11 big + 14x6 small = 249 (assumed like Standard); the catalogue only proves >= 239 (max index 238, 77 routes)

general.description: All distributions: the BLE index of a hold is its backend hold id. The state vector length is realHoldsLength = number of holds + internal id gaps (= max id - min id + 1).
general.index_rule: ids are assigned when an admin builds the wall: each tapped grid cell gets the next counter value (tap order, normally the LED chain order). No fixed rule; per-wall data.

5.description: Standard (st1, st2, st4, st5): 35 rows; offset rows (half-cell inset, columns-1 cells) are the even rows plus rows 1 and rows-2 (app numbering from the top); other rows are full rows.
5.index_rule: BLE order: 18 big rows bottom->top, 2 kicker rows (lowest first), 1 placeholder, 15 small rows bottom->top; every index row alternates direction, the first runs left->right.

6.description: Standard Mini (st0): 29 rows; even rows (from the top) are offset rows, odd rows full rows; no kicker rows.
6.index_rule: big rows 0-164 identical to Standard B0-B14; small rows assumed like Standard (low).

0.description: NormalVertical: plain rows x columns grid (custom walls).

3.description: Floating: free-positioned holds (floatingHolds list), vector length from that list.

7.description: PolygonHolds: polygon-shaped holds (polyHolds list), vector length from that list.

notes: Only the index (BLE vector position) is safety-relevant for lighting; x/y/col/row only affect drawing, editor taps and heatmaps.
kind: big | kicker | small | placeholder. present=false: index exists in the vector but no hold is drawn (always send 0).
st1/st4 and st2/st5 share indices 0-219 resp. 0-339 at identical positions; st4 = central 12 columns of st5 (offset 3).
st3 (Standard Mini Full) is left out: no catalogue data.

Hold names follow the app's asset names (letter = column from the left, x,y,z first on Max walls; number = row from the bottom). Big-hold and small-hold names are anchored (photo shapes, missing assets p7m/p10z); kicker names pz1 (lower) / pz2 (upper) are by analogy.
Real walls can deviate (each wall's hold list lives in the vendor backend). An official vendor table should replace this file.
